hooks.prompt: Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if you are currently operating as a GRADER (running dimension reviews, computing scores, generating grade reports). If you are NOT in a grading role (e.g. you are an engineer, tester, or debugger), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this restriction only applies to grading sessions. If you ARE the grader, check: the file being written must be a report output file (.md, .json, .html). Writing source code files (.svelte, .ts, .tsx, .js, .css, .scss) is FORBIDDEN for the grader — show fix suggestions as code examples inside the report instead. Respond {"ok": true} if the write is allowed, or {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Grader must not write source files"} if blocked.

Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if you are currently operating as a GRADER (running dimension reviews, computing scores, generating grade reports). If you are NOT in a grading role (e.g. you are an engineer, tester, or debugger), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this restriction only applies to grading sessions. If you ARE the grader, check: graders must ONLY run read-only analysis commands. BLOCK: rm/delete operations, git push/commit/write operations, npm/pnpm/yarn install (unless --dry-run), npm/pnpm/yarn publish, sed -i or in-place file editing, shell output redirection to source files (.svelte, .ts, .js, .css), chmod 777. ALLOW: cat, head, grep, find, ls, git log/diff/status/show, npx svelte-check, npx tsc --noEmit, eslint (read-only). Respond {"ok": true} if the command is safe for a grader, or {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Graders must only run read-only commands"} if blocked.

Validate this grading report output: $ARGUMENTS. Check that: 1) All dimension scores are in the range 0-100 or explicitly marked N/A with justification, 2) Each finding includes a code example as evidence and a fix suggestion, 3) Severity levels are one of: critical, major, minor, info, 4) No production code was written directly into submission source files — fix suggestions appear only as examples inside the report content. Respond {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "..."}.

Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if this session involved grading a codebase (running dimension reviewers, computing scores, generating grade reports). If NO grading work was performed in this session, respond {"ok": true} immediately — this hook only applies to grading sessions. If grading WAS performed, verify: 1) All 8 grading dimensions have been scored or explicitly marked N/A with written justification — dimensions are: component quality, state management, styling/CSS, accessibility, performance, TypeScript usage, testing quality, UX patterns, 2) A weighted composite aggregate score has been computed from the dimension scores, 3) A final grading report has been generated with executive summary, dimension scorecards, findings with evidence, and fix suggestions. Respond {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: list what is incomplete or absent"}.
